name: CINCINNATI
description: Cincinnati is a poker card game that involves betting, hand rankings, bluffing. The game originated in USA and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: Cincinnati is a poker card game that involves betting, hand rankings, bluffing. The game originated in USA and has become popular worldwide.

Country/Region of Origin: USA
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space
Five cards face down to each player, then five cards face down to the table. Dealer turns table cards face up one at a time; after each card a betting round. Clockwise from dealer.

items.text: High card of suit splits pot: Holder of the highest card of the suit of a particular table card (often the last or third turned) splits the pot with the highest hand. Alternatively: high hand splits with holder of highest card of that suit if table card is 8 or higher, or with lowest card of the suit if 7 or lower.
Last table card wild: The last table card turned over and all cards of the same rank are wild.
Low Hole Cincinnati: Each player's lowest hole card is wild for that player, along with any others of the same rank.
